verdict.rationale: Gusto documents its own guided flow for forming the company, registering an EIN, and opening a business bank account, and promises a "day-one" account with no lengthy application or branch visit. That points to onboarding well under a week. However, the feature is in early beta with limited rollout, and banking runs through partner Increase Bank. The community source only repeats the press claim. Missing for 10: general availability beyond early beta, documented end-to-end onboarding timelines or requirements, and independent hands-on confirmation of the speed.

support.subject: As a founder, I can fully onboard onto a new banking platform in about a week instead of months

citations.quote: A day-one business bank account: no lengthy application, no branch visit, no minimum balance.
helping entrepreneurs form their company, register for an EIN, and open a business bank account in a single guided flow.
These capabilities are in early beta and will roll out to more entrepreneurs in the coming months.
